title: Blowing up commutes with flat base change
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a flat morphism X_1 -> X_2, a closed subscheme Z_2 of X_2 with inverse image Z_1 in X_1, and the blowups X'_i of Z_i in X_i, there is a cartesian diagram relating X'_1 to X_1 x_{X_2} X'_2 (source lines 8350-8366). The proof identifies the ideal sheaf of Z_1 as the image of g^*I_2 -> O_{X_1}, uses the base change formula for the relative Proj of a graded algebra to describe X_1 x_{X_2} X'_2 as Proj of the coproduct of the g^*I_2^n, and uses flatness to see that g^*I_2^n -> O_{X_1} is injective with image I_1^n, so the two relative Proj agree.
